ios.desc:
Hummm - Talk to a real person, one on one, about what's on your mind

Sometimes you just need someone to talk to. Whether you want to share your thoughts, discuss ideas, talk about your day, or just need a listening ear—Hummm connects you with real people for genuine one-on-one conversations.

TALK TO SOMEONE REAL

Share what's on your mind in a safe, judgment-free space. No bots, no AI—just real human conversations that feel natural and authentic.

WHY HUMMM?

VOICE & TEXT MESSAGING
Connect through voice messages or text—whatever feels comfortable. Express yourself authentically and have real conversations at your own pace.
REAL CONVERSATIONS
Talk to genuine people for meaningful one-on-one conversations. Share what's on your mind in a safe, judgment-free space where you can be yourself.
ANONYMOUS & PRIVATE
Your privacy matters. Stay completely anonymous—no names, no photos, no personal information required. Share only what you want, when you want.
NO SIGN-UP REQUIRED
Get started instantly. Just download and start talking. No email, no phone number, no registration barriers—real conversations are just a tap away.
ALWAYS FREE
Hummm is completely free—no subscriptions, no premium tiers, no hidden costs. Everyone deserves access to genuine human connection.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Open the app and share what's on your mind (no sign-up needed)
2. Browse what others are thinking about or wait for someone to reach out
3. Connect through voice or text messages—one message at a time
4. Have meaningful conversations in a judgment-free space

FEATURES
* Voice and text messaging for flexible expression
* Anonymous first—your privacy is protected
* Topic-based connections to find like-minded people
* Real one-on-one conversations
* Safe, judgment-free community
* No sign-up or personal information required
* Completely free, forever

WHAT TO TALK ABOUT
Hummm is here for any conversation:
* Your thoughts and ideas
* Daily experiences
* Things you're excited about
* Challenges you're facing
* Questions on your mind
* Perspectives you're seeking
* Stories you want to share
* Or anything else you want to discuss

WHO IS HUMMM FOR?
Hummm is for anyone who wants to talk:
* Share your thoughts with someone who listens
* Discuss ideas and get perspectives
* Connect with real people
* Have genuine conversations
* Talk about what matters to you
* Anyone seeking authentic human connection
